description.value: O'Keefe Ranch is a historic living museum near Vernon, BC, preserving one of British Columbia's oldest cattle ranches across a sprawling multi-building property with year-round resident farm animals. Operated by the O'Keefe Ranch & Interior Heritage Society, the site offers seasonal heritage exhibitions, glamping, and community events from spring through fall. Touring cyclists will find it a substantial destination stop along Hwy 97, with an on-site restaurant and a property covering roughly 1.2 km of walking through heritage buildings and grounds.
